stories.title: Cotton and the Lost Star
stories.tagline: A little bunny helps a star find its way home
stories.description: One night, a little star fell into the meadow. Cotton the bunny gently helps it back up to the sky, and learns that a small kindness can light up the whole night.

stories.title: Little Bear Isn’t Sleepy
stories.tagline: Little Bear learns to relax and drift off to sleep
stories.description: It is late, but Little Bear Mun is still wide awake. With help from Grandpa Owl, the Fireflies and the stars, Mun learns to breathe slowly and sleep soundly.

stories.title: The Little Whale’s Lullaby
stories.tagline: Blue finds a new friend in the night sea
stories.description: Tonight, little whale Blue has to sing alone in the dark sea. Then Little Jelly appears, glowing like a lantern, and Blue’s song brings Mama home.

stories.title: Cloud the Kitten Looks for Sleep
stories.tagline: A kitten searches for her lost sleep
stories.description: Cloud the kitten has lost her sleep. She asks the Wind, she asks the Fireflies, and at last she finds her sleep somewhere very close.

stories.title: Duckling’s Moonlight Swim
stories.tagline: Little Yellow is no longer afraid of the dark
stories.description: Little Yellow is scared of the dark pond. With help from Sister Moon and the Little Fish, Little Yellow finds that the night is gentle too.

stories.title: Green Frog Counts the Stars
stories.tagline: Count to five with Green Frog, then sleep
stories.description: Green Frog sits on a lily pad and counts the stars. One, two, three, four, five… and before he knows it, his eyes are closing.

stories.title: Little Turtle Goes Home
stories.tagline: Little Turtle’s journey to the sea
stories.description: Little Turtle has just hatched on the sand. With the moonlight and Red Crab showing the way, Little Turtle bravely crawls home to the blue sea.

stories.title: Little Fox and the Lantern
stories.tagline: A lantern that lights up friendship
stories.description: Little Fox has a star-shaped lantern. Along the way, Little Fox uses its light to help friends in the forest find their way home.

stories.title: Little Elephant Wants to Sleep
stories.tagline: Little Elephant looks for a cozy place to sleep
stories.description: Little Elephant is so big that every bed feels too small. He tries a tree, a burrow and the lake shore, and finally finds the very best place to sleep.

stories.title: The Penguin Who Dreamed of Flying
stories.description: Little Penguin wishes he could fly like the seagull. That night, in a dream, Little Penguin soars up into the glowing northern lights.

stories.title: Brown Squirrel Hides His Acorns
stories.description: Brown Squirrel hides lots of acorns to save for winter. But when a friend is hungry, Brown Squirrel does something very sweet.
